native_cadence.AI_unit_mapping: AI_LEN_REG>>2 is current-buffer stereo-frame occupancy because native AI frame=4 bytes. A separate two-buffer native ledger holds complete accepted buffers. Monotonic nanoseconds consume frames at32006 with fractional-frame carry and overflow-safe splitting. Head remainder, not summed host source queue bytes or converted SDL output bytes, is sampled on scheduler retrace and lagged into the next task build.
native_cadence.bootstrap: The initial task may build before the first source retrace. First session-local notification's zero-count buffer0 produces no output submission/accepted frames/native AI credit. Completed PCM remains leased until the second actual session-local notification; an externally supplied first ordinal10 is not ten notifications. If notifications already coalesced before initial publication, a further notification is required rather than inventing post-publication output credit. Later completed tasks require the next actual notification after build.
native_cadence.mailbox: One pending retrace bit mirrors the source one-message nonblocking queue. Further scheduler notifications while an executing or PCM lease blocks the owner do not create a task backlog. Monotonic native AI consumption still advances independently, retaining fractional clock progress even while AI is empty. Source command/float volume-controller updates occur once after task publication and its available source tick. An already-pending initial tick is consumed by the initial post-build update; if the initial build precedes that tick, its deferred update runs exactly once when the first tick arrives while the real task/PCM owner stays fenced. No presentation count drives these updates.

ownership.commands: Game requests, processed native player state, task publication, actual executor terminal, completed PCM lease, native-endian extraction, partial consumer acceptance and stream drain are separate states. Native CSP stopping means an actual release/drain is already pending, not the original SDK's opaque state value: source requests map playing to stop, stopping to wait, stopped to source phase advance. Repeated native stop would retarget the fifty-ms release indefinitely and is not emitted while draining. Live commands never write published RDRAM. ownership.SFX_generations: Every service update first checks and retires all existing native playback handles before allocating any new start, because facade slot order can differ from native descriptor order after stealing. A bounded start-eligibility mask preserves GAME's one-iteration replacement delay for a just-retired slot. No stale later-slot handle is inspected after an earlier start may have reused that native descriptor.
ownership.PCM: One fixed max_frames*2 native S16 scratch is populated once from the completed canonical BE16 lease. A consumer must synchronously own its reported accepted prefix. WouldBlock/partial output retains the remainder and lease; no duplicate prefix, repeated conversion, hidden task or per-service allocation occurs. Explicit abandon_pcm is abort/discard, never drain.

Re-register only then; allocation/task identities stay stable/monotonic. Effects recreation validates every scalar and synthesis-rate-specific chorus constraint before any mutation.
